about: Where a kiosk's kitchen bon goes (printing.bonOnKiosk: true | false | "auto", auto by default — the owner 17.10.2026: "one printer can be everything"; pos-server docs/SPEC_KIOSK.md §29.1). The same bytes in pos-android app/src/test/resources and pos-server kiosk-desktop/test/fixtures; Android domain/KioskOrders.kt KioskBon.route + ownShare + isOwnPrinter, kiosk-desktop core/kioskBonRoute.ts. single: one named bon printer (bonMode single); singleOwn: that printer is the kiosk's own (its USB port or head, hosted by it, or a receipt printer set to it alone — the Windows kiosk prints everything on its own); kitchenPrinters: the kitchen printers that may take the kiosk's orders; kds: the KDS takes the order (absent: false); ownPrinter: the kiosk has a printer of its own that would take it (Android: its USB printer; Windows: always). auto: the kitchen printers if any, else the KDS if it takes the order, else the kiosk's own printer (none without one — no alert per order). true: as auto, and the routing's share for this till (ownShare) prints on the kiosk; no printer at all: the routing, which says none takes it. false (a level chose it): never on the kiosk.
